ability.guimi_mod.aby_keen_intuition.des: Every 3s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 4s to hostile creatures within 12 blocks that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_conscience.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_inhuman_body.desc: Direct non-fire damage taken is reduced by 15%.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_poison_fire.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 15s. Up to 1 targets within 12 blocks along your look. Deals 5 magic damage and applies Poison I for 6s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_slowness.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 25s. Up to 1 targets within 12 blocks along your look and applies Slowness II for 10s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_evil_words.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 20s. Up to 1 targets within 12 blocks along your look and applies Weakness I for 15s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_conscience_lost.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_demon_ritual.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_demon_projection.d: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 5 min. Summons 2 vex beside you, health 14, attack 6, for 1 min. Friendly summons attack nearby enemies and despawn when the time ends.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_anti_divination.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_serial_expertise.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_demonize.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 5 min. Grants yourself Strength III, Speed II, Resistance II, Jump Boost III, Slow Falling I, Demon Form I for 45s.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_malice_sense.desc: Every 3s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 4s to creatures within 20 blocks that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_magma_sword.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 30s. Gives you a magma sword. If your inventory is full, it drops at your feet.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_sulfur_fireball.de: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 10s. Up to 1 targets within 20 blocks along your look. Deals 7 magic damage and applies Poison I for 5s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_flame_cage.desc: Costs 12 mana, cooldown 25s. Up to 1 targets within 12 blocks along your look and applies Slowness VII for 5s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_foul_slow.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Affects hostile creatures within 8 blocks, applies Slowness VI for 2s.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_foul_death.desc: Costs 40 mana, cooldown 2 min. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look. Deals 19 magic damage. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_foul_corrupt.desc: Costs 25 mana, cooldown 60s. Around a target within 12 blocks along your look, deals 8 magic damage to hostile creatures within 5 blocks and applies Abyss Corruption for 8s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_immunity.desc: Every 2s. applies Fire Resistance I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_cold_blood.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.aby_lose_control.desc: Every 60s, 10% chance to apply hidden Nausea I for 5s and reduce sanity by 1.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_potion_boost.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_poison_resist.des: Every 2s. If you are poisoned, 50% chance to remove it.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_herb_identify.des: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_animal_affinity.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_tame_master.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_beast_speech.desc: Costs 3 mana, cooldown 5s. Makes animals you tamed within 30 blocks attack the last creature that hurt you. Refunds mana if none can be commanded.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_beast_summon.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 2 min. Recruits up to 3 non-hostile, non-tameable creatures within 15 blocks to fight with you. They do not despawn on the normal summon timer. Refunds mana if none are found.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_life_drain.desc: Costs 10 mana, 25 second cooldown. Deals 10 magic damage to the target within 5 blocks of your look and heals you for the health it actually lost. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_vampire_fangs.des: After a direct melee hit, heal for 15% of the damage actually dealt.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_night_power.desc: Damage dealt is +20% at night and -15% during the day.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_bat_form.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. Grants Resistance V, Slow Falling, Jump Boost IV, Invisibility, and Bat Form for 15s, and summons 6 bats with 6 health and 2 attack for 1 min.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_blood_lure.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Pulls non-player creatures within 8 blocks toward you. Hostile ones also take 2 magic damage. Refunds mana if none are found.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_abyss_shackle.des: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 15s. Up to 1 targets within 8 blocks along your look and applies Slowness VIII for 10s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_dark_wings.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 40s. Grants Speed III and Slow Falling for 15s, and deals 5 magic damage to hostile creatures within 5 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_corrosion_claw.de: Direct melee hits deal 2 extra damage.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_blood_servant.des: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. Turns a non-player creature within 6 blocks along your look into a blood servant for 1 min. It follows you and attacks your target. Refunds mana for players or if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_potion_mastery.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_blood_potion.desc: No mana cost, 15 second cooldown. Spends 4 of your health to heal the target within 8 blocks of your look for 6, or yourself if there is no target. Fails if your health is 4 or less.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_toxin_master.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.moon_mutation_potion.d: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 90s. applies Nausea I, Poison I, Strength II, Speed II, Resistance II, Fire Resistance I, Jump Boost III, Invisibility I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_harvest_hand.desc: Every 5s. Applies bone meal to up to 4 spots within 4 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_nature_affinity.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_diagnose.desc: Costs 1 mana, cooldown 3s. Reports the name, health, and max health of a target within 10 blocks along your look. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_first_aid.desc: Costs 10 mana, 40 second cooldown. Heals the target within 8 blocks of your look for 8 and clears common negative effects, or yourself if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_disease_resist.des: Every 3s. Removes Poison, Wither, and Hunger from you.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_harvest_blessing.d: Costs 25 mana, cooldown 2 min. Bone-meals up to 60 crops within 15 blocks, and grants you and allies Regeneration II and Saturation for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_thorns.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 25s. Affects hostile creatures within 5 blocks. Deals 2 magic damage, applies Slowness III, Poison I for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_nature_heal.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 45s. Clears common negative effects from you and allies within 10 blocks, and heals each for 10.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_earth_power.desc: While standing on grass, dirt, coarse dirt, podzol, or farmland, every 2s refreshes hidden Strength II and Resistance II for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_bio_modify.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 5 min. Raises max health and attack by 30% on a tamed, not-yet-modified animal within 8 blocks along your look, and fills its health. Each animal can be modified once. Refunds mana if it does not qualify.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_nature_wrath.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 1 min. Affects hostile creatures within 15 blocks. Deals 8 magic damage, applies Slowness V for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_life_share.desc: Costs 20 mana, 3 minute cooldown. Averages your current health with another player within 10 blocks of your look, capped at each maximum. Refunds mana if the target is not a player.
ability.guimi_mod.mot_plague_aura.desc: Every 3s. Removes Poison and Wither from you and from allies within 8 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.err_steal.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 20s. Takes the main-hand item of a creature within 5 blocks along your look. Refunds mana if that hand is empty or there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_agile_hands.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Haste I, Speed I.
ability.guimi_mod.err_keen_observation.d: Every 5s. Makes dropped items within 10 blocks glow.
ability.guimi_mod.err_short_blade.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_constitution.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Health Boost I, Speed I.
ability.guimi_mod.err_micro_expression.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_charisma.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_eloquence.desc: Costs 5 mana, 30 second cooldown. Makes the mob within 10 blocks of your look drop its attack target. Refunds mana if there is no mob.
ability.guimi_mod.err_mislead.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 45s. Makes a creature within 10 blocks along your look attack the nearest other creature within 10 blocks. Refunds mana if there is no valid target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_mind_disturb.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 25s. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Nausea I for 10s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_agility.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Speed I.
ability.guimi_mod.err_clue_analysis.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 30s. Applies Glowing I for 10s to creatures within 10 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.err_dream_analysis.des: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_puzzle_deduce.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_spirit_intuition.d: Every 3s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 4s to invisible creatures within 15 blocks, or to creatures there that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.err_trace_reading.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.err_ability_steal.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 3 min. Range 50 blocks along your look. A normal cast steals an item from the target; sneaking plants a dangerous item in its main hand and takes the old one. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.err_telekinesis.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Pulls dropped items within 50 blocks toward you. Refunds mana if there are none.
ability.guimi_mod.err_treasure_sense.des: Every 10s. Makes dropped items within 50 blocks glow.
ability.guimi_mod.err_body_boost.desc: Refreshes a hidden effect every 2s: Strength I, Speed I, Health Boost II.
ability.guimi_mod.err_pollution_resist.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_open_door.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Passes through a wall in front of you up to about 3 blocks thick if the far side is standable. Refunds mana if there is no wall or it is too thick.
ability.guimi_mod.door_ritual.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_space_intuition.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_escape_instinct.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_flash.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 12s. Affects hostile creatures within 5 blocks, applies Blindness I, Glowing I for 3s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_black_curtain.des: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. Affects nearby creatures within 3 blocks, applies Darkness I for 8s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_gas_transfer.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Removes Poison from you and allies within 15 blocks, then applies Poison I for 10s to one hostile creature within 15 blocks. Refunds mana if nobody was poisoned.
ability.guimi_mod.door_loud_bang.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. Affects nearby creatures within 10 blocks, applies Nausea I for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_freeze.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 12s. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Slowness III for 5s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_shock.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 8s. Up to 1 targets within 3 blocks along your look. Deals 3 magic damage and applies Slowness VI for 2s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_fog.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 25s. Applies Darkness I for 20s to creatures within 15 blocks and releases smoke particles around you.
ability.guimi_mod.door_wind.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 10s. Affects nearby creatures within 8 blocks, and knocks them back.
ability.guimi_mod.door_ignite.desc: Costs 3 mana, 3 second cooldown. Sets the target within 3 blocks of your look on fire for 5 seconds. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_trip.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 15s. Up to 1 targets within 10 blocks along your look and applies Slowness V for 3s. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_trip_area.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 20s. Affects nearby creatures within 6 blocks, applies Slowness IV for 6s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_move_object.desc: Costs 3 mana, cooldown 5s. Throws dropped items within 5 blocks along your look. Refunds mana if there are none.
ability.guimi_mod.door_escape_trick.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 20s. Blinks along your look, up to 5 blocks, onto a standable spot.
Every 3s. Applies hidden Glowing I for 4s to creatures within 16 blocks that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.door_astrology.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 45s. applies Luck I for 1 min.
ability.guimi_mod.door_anti_divination.d: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_star_knowledge.de: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_record.desc: Costs 5 mana, 10 second cooldown. Records the name of the target within 20 blocks of your look for Record Release. Refunds mana if there is no target.
ability.guimi_mod.door_record_release.de: Costs 15 mana, 30 second cooldown. Requires a recorded target. Consumes the record, then deals 3 magic damage to the target within 15 blocks of your look. Refunds mana if there is no record.
ability.guimi_mod.door_record_manage.des: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.door_spirit_boost.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.be_distortion.desc: Costs 30 mana, cooldown 20s. Enters distortion mode for 15s; cast again to exit. While in mode: invert movement for 5s, redirect attacks for 5s, deflect projectiles for 3s, seal around a door, isolate a room, and hijack a player's divination for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.door_distortion.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 20s. Enters distortion mode for 15s; cast again to exit. Allows movement inversion for 5s, projectile deflection for 3s, a door seal, and room isolation. Attack redirect and divination hijack are denied.
ability.guimi_mod.whl_distortion.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 20s. Enters distortion mode for 15s; cast again to exit. Allows attack redirect for 5s, projectile deflection for 3s, and divination hijack on a player for 30s. Movement inversion, door seals, and room isolation are denied.
ability.guimi_mod.seer_divination.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Makes monsters within 16 blocks glow for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.fighting_mastery.desc: Every 2s, refreshes Strength I and Speed I for 4.5s. Fall damage is reduced to 20%.
ability.guimi_mod.flying_card.desc: Costs 1 mana, cooldown 0.5s. Consumes paper and throws a card. In scatter mode it throws 5 cards at sequence 6 or lower, otherwise 3. It does not cast without paper.
ability.guimi_mod.damage_transfer.desc: Fake health absorbs damage first and drops by 1 per second. At 0 fake health, a fatal hit is cancelled, health becomes 1, and you gain 30 fake health.
ability.guimi_mod.water_breathing.desc: While underwater, refreshes Water Breathing every 2s for 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.bone_softening.desc: In a cobweb or powder snow, horizontal speed is tripled and vertical speed is 1.5 times. Sneaking into a low gap makes you crawl; crawling slows you and blocks item use.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_jump.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Teleports to fire or a lit campfire within 2 blocks of a block you look at, up to 30 blocks away. Does not teleport if no fire is found.
ability.guimi_mod.air_bullet.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 2s. Fires an air bullet that deals 5 damage.
ability.guimi_mod.paper_substitute.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 30s. Teleports to the nearest paper figurine within 10 blocks and consumes it. Fails with no figurine or while abyss-corrupted.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_control.desc: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 3s. Ignites a target within 30 blocks along your look for 6s and deals 2 fire damage. With no target, lights a fire at the crosshair.
ability.guimi_mod.illusion.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Places an illusion up to 30 blocks along your look. Creatures within 16 blocks drop their target and move there.
ability.guimi_mod.disguise.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 15s. Makes creatures within 32 blocks that are targeting you drop that target.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_jump_advanced.de: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Teleports to fire or a lit campfire within 2 blocks of a block you look at, up to 45 blocks away. Does not teleport if no fire is found.
ability.guimi_mod.air_bullet_advanced.de: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 2s. Fires an air bullet that deals 8 damage.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_control_advanced: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 3s. Ignites a target within 30 blocks along your look for 6s and deals 2.6 fire damage. With no target, lights a fire at the crosshair.
ability.guimi_mod.paper_substitute_advan: Costs 6 mana, cooldown 7.5s. Teleports to the nearest paper figurine within 10 blocks and consumes it. Fails with no figurine or while abyss-corrupted.
ability.guimi_mod.spirit_thread_vision.d: Costs 2 mana, cooldown 1s. Only sequence 9 can toggle spirit vision. While on, grants Night Vision for 15s and makes creatures within 30 blocks glow.
Costs 15 mana, cooldown 30s. Controls a creature within 20 blocks for 5s, applying Slowness III, Mining Fatigue III, and Glowing.
ability.guimi_mod.marionette_combat.desc: Costs 3 mana, cooldown 2s. Orders your marionette to attack a target within 24 blocks along your look. It cannot be used without a marionette.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_mastery.desc: Once unlocked, flame control lights a 3×3 area when it has no target. It does not apply a continuous effect by itself.
ability.guimi_mod.shared_vision.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 1s. Toggles marionette control.
ability.guimi_mod.light_footsteps.desc: Keeps Jump Boost I and Slow Falling refreshed. Sprinting grants +10% speed. Fall damage is cancelled.
ability.guimi_mod.eagle_eye.desc: Keeps Night Vision refreshed. Every 2s, makes creatures 12 to 32 blocks away glow.
ability.guimi_mod.shadow_hiding.desc: While the block you stand in has brightness 4 or less, refreshes Invisibility every 0.5s for 1.5s.
ability.guimi_mod.weakpoint_strike.desc: A sneak attack from behind the target deals double damage. Internal cooldown 5s.
ability.guimi_mod.constitution_boost.des: Max health +4, and Resistance I is kept refreshed.
ability.guimi_mod.charm.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 60s. On a creature within 10 blocks: hostile ones are calmed for 30s, others follow you for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.misdirect.desc: Cast in two steps, range 15 blocks. First pick a source creature, then a new target, and rewrite its attack for 15s. The class also counts 10 mana and a 45s cooldown.
ability.guimi_mod.persuade.desc: Interacting with a villager grants Hero of the Village II for 10s. If the villager has fewer than 12 offers, there is a 15% chance to add a trade of 6 soyle for 3 experience bottles.
ability.guimi_mod.gender_transition.desc: Recorded sequence trait. It has no extra effect.
ability.guimi_mod.witch_invisibility.des: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 90s. Starts invisibility, with a 2s transition, lasting 30s. Attacking or taking damage interrupts it.
ability.guimi_mod.black_flame.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Fires 1 black flame that deals 6 damage.
ability.guimi_mod.frost_control.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 10s. Freezes a target within 8 blocks for 3s and applies slowness. With no creature, it acts on the looked-at block.
ability.guimi_mod.mirror_divination.desc: Triggered by the mirror item. Costs 10 mana, cooldown 20s. The mirror will not start divination without this ability.
ability.guimi_mod.mirror_substitute.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 120s. Teleports to the saved mirror anchor. Fails with no anchor or while abyss-corrupted. Without mastery, the anchor is cleared. A fatal hit also tries to trigger it.
ability.guimi_mod.wand_substitute.desc: Costs 20 mana, cooldown 120s. Teleports to the player holding the wand bound to you. Fails while abyss-corrupted. A fatal hit also tries to trigger it.
ability.guimi_mod.charm_aura.desc: Every 3s. An uncharmed creature within 10 blocks has a 15% chance to be calmed for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.mirror_mastery.desc: After mirror substitute teleports, there is a 50% chance to keep the anchor. Without this, the anchor is always cleared.
ability.guimi_mod.spider_silk.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 15s. Applies Slowness IV and Mining Fatigue for 8s to a target within 20 blocks. Sneaking instead pulls you toward the target.
ability.guimi_mod.cocoon.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 120s. Enters a cocoon for 5s. Non-fire damage is cancelled; fire damage breaks the cocoon and is doubled.
ability.guimi_mod.black_flame_advanced.d: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 5s. Fires 7 black flames, 8 damage each. Sneaking instead clears all of your negative effects and does not fire.
ability.guimi_mod.ice_spear.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 10s. Throws an ice spear forward.
ability.guimi_mod.frost_armor.desc: Costs 15 mana, cooldown 90s. Activates frost armor for 20s. Damage taken is reduced by 30% during that time.
ability.guimi_mod.curse.desc: Costs 50 mana, cooldown 120s. Requires a mirror in hand. Applies Blindness, Slowness, Weakness, or Poison at random to a target within 15 blocks for 30s.
ability.guimi_mod.body_enhancement.desc: Max health +4, and Strength I and Speed I are kept refreshed.
ability.guimi_mod.trace_tracking.desc: Records nearby creature tracks every second. Sneak-right-click the ground with an empty hand to reveal them.
ability.guimi_mod.weakness_insight.desc: Sneaking observes and analyzes a target. Melee damage against an analyzed target is +30%.
ability.guimi_mod.wild_knowledge.desc: Sneak-right-click a block: paper plus 2 sweet berries makes a hemostatic salve; a glass bottle plus a spider eye makes basic poison.
ability.guimi_mod.danger_sense.desc: Every 0.5s, checks creatures within 8 blocks that are moving or targeting you. The base version only senses those behind you. Danger plays a heartbeat and sets the danger flag.
ability.guimi_mod.war_constitution.desc: Max health +2. While hunger is at least 18, heals 0.5 every 4s.
ability.guimi_mod.weakness_insight_advan: When analysis completes, also lists the target's sensitive traits in chat. The damage bonus still comes from weakness insight.
ability.guimi_mod.provoke.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 5 mana and has a 20s cooldown. Enrages a creature within 15 blocks. A known type lasts 20s, otherwise 5s. Enraged attacks can miss.
ability.guimi_mod.pyro_fire_resistance.d: Clears fire immediately if you are burning. Fire damage taken is reduced by 80%. Explosion damage is not reduced.
While spirit vision is on, every 0.5s marks nearby creatures' ether colors for you only.
Danger sense covers 360 degrees within 8 blocks. Every 5s it also notes stalkers farther away that are targeting you.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_enchant.desc: A direct melee hit ignites a non-fire-immune target for 4s.
ability.guimi_mod.fireball.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The first cast starts charging; the next releases it. A red fireball costs 5 mana and has a 3s cooldown; the compressed white one costs 10 mana and has an 8s cooldown. A full charge is about 4s.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_armor.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 30s. Activates flame armor for 15s. Melee attackers take 2 thorns damage and burn for 2s. Freeze damage is halved.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_weapon.desc: Costs 10 mana, cooldown 20s. Gives a flame weapon for 1 min. If flame shaping is unlocked, the weapon uses that branch.
ability.guimi_mod.delayed_blast.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. If you already have a flame trap within 30 blocks, it detonates that trap; otherwise it spends 8 mana and throws one.
ability.guimi_mod.fire_injection.desc: Costs 5 mana, cooldown 10s. Arms for 3s. The next melee hit during that window injects a delayed blast into the target.
ability.guimi_mod.fire_raven.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 8 mana and has a 12s cooldown. Sends 5 fire ravens at a target within 15 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.white_flame_spear.desc: Costs 8 mana, cooldown 15s. Throws a white flame spear forward.
ability.guimi_mod.burning_wall.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 10 mana and has a 25s cooldown. Places a fire wall for 8s up to 20 blocks along your look.
ability.guimi_mod.giant_fireball.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. Start charging, then cast again to release. Costs 20 mana, cooldown 60s. Charge time is 15 to 20s, halved if white compression is unlocked.
ability.guimi_mod.intellect_boost.desc: Keeps Hero of the Village I refreshed. Interacting with a villager upgrades it to Hero of the Village III for 10s.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_shaping.desc: Unlocks the shaping branch of the flame weapon. It does not apply a continuous effect by itself.
ability.guimi_mod.white_compression.desc: Unlocks the compressed branch of fireball charging and the giant fireball. It does not apply a continuous effect by itself.
ability.guimi_mod.fire_body.desc: On a direct physical hit that is not fire or an explosion, if ready, become fire for 3s and cancel that hit. Cooldown 90s. In that form those physical hits are cancelled, and freeze damage is doubled.
ability.guimi_mod.intel_network.desc: Interacting with a villager has a 30% chance to report another employed player within 64 blocks, rounded to about 10 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.mislead.desc: Cast in two steps, range 20 blocks. First pick a source, then rewrite its attack for 30s. The class also counts 10 mana and a 45s cooldown.
ability.guimi_mod.incite.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 12 mana and has a 60s cooldown. Makes non-hostile creatures within 10 blocks attack a target within 20 blocks along your look for 20s.
ability.guimi_mod.flame_leap.desc: The spell itself costs no mana. The cast spends 8 mana and has an 8s cooldown. Leaps to your own fireball, flame trap, or fire wall within 30 blocks.
ability.guimi_mod.characteristic_herding: Every second, slowly pulls same-pathway or neighboring-pathway characteristic items within 8 times the configured attraction range toward you.
